title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. Draw a two-dimensional sketch on the first face. In the first loop, start by drawing a line from the origin (0.0, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.0). Next, draw a line from (0.75, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.0938), followed by a line from (0.75, 0.0938) to (0.0, 0.0938), and finally, a line from (0.0, 0.0938) back to the origin. Apply a scale factor of 0.75 to the entire two-dimensional sketch. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three-dimensional space by rotating it with Euler angles set to zero and translating it with a vector also set to zero. Extrude the two-dimensional sketch 0.0131 units along the normal direction without extruding in the opposite direction. This process will create a new solid body with a length of 0.7500000000000001 units, a width of 0.09375000000000001 units, and a height of 0.013125000000000001 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.75, 0).lineTo(0.75, 0.0938).lineTo(0, 0.0938).close()

# Extrude the sketch
extrusion = sketch.extrude(0.0131)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = extrusion

import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a sketch on the XY plane
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0938) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0938) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create a rectangular bar
r = r.extrude(0.0131)
